hero.headline: Strategic Technical Leadership for Enterprise Scale
hero.subheadline: I help organizations build scalable systems, high-performing engineering teams, and robust technical strategies.

about.title: Principal Technical Consultant
about.bio: With over 15 years of experience in distributed systems and cloud architecture, I partner with CTOs and engineering leaders to solve complex technical challenges. My focus is on delivering sustainable business value through engineering excellence, not just writing code.

services.title: Fractional CTO / VPE
services.description: Strategic technical leadership for startups and scale-ups. I help define roadmap, hire key talent, and establish engineering culture.

services.title: Architecture Modernization
services.description: Comprehensive audit of existing systems with a roadmap for migration to modern, scalable patterns (microservices, serverless, edge).

services.title: Technical Due Diligence
services.description: Deep-dive assessment of code quality, scalability, and security for investors and M&A activities.

projects.title: Fintech Core Banking Migration
projects.description: Led the architectural migration of a legacy monolith to event-driven microservices for a Series D fintech, handling $5B+ annual transaction volume.

projects.title: Healthcare Data Platform
projects.description: Designed and implemented a HIPAA-compliant data lake and analytics platform processing 50TB+ of patient data.

projects.title: Global E-Commerce Replatform
projects.description: Orchestrated the headless commerce transition for a global retailer, improving site performance (LCP) by 60% and conversion by 15%.
